study_protocol.title: Finite synthetic evidence loss and restoration feasibility pilot
study_protocol.question: Can a fixed plain model complete matched-fact facts/EAL/conventional decision tasks across critical evidence loss, positive and negative restoration, and noncritical gaps, while separate measurements distinguish substantive answer correctness from canonical decision correctness?

scope.system_or_population: Eight fresh AI-authored fictional source tasks: two logic families crossed with four availability causes, each with five scheduled evidence conditions.
scope.conditions: Pinned plain model gpt-4.1-nano-2025-04-14; one repeat; no native tools for donors or recipients; three reasoner contexts; prompted JSON; USD 2 cumulative budget.
scope.spatial_scope: Repository fixture state and API execution only; no people, deployment, or physical assets.
scope.temporal_scope: One common actual donor at position 0 and fresh independently cloned recipients at positions 2, 4, 6, 8, 10. These are artificial snapshot times, not actual longitudinal field observations.
exclusions: Population reliability, human developer outcomes, independent human task authoring, pure reasoning capability, model-class effects, superiority, cost savings, and principal-study power.
Existing pilot outcomes are motivation only and are not pooled with follow-up outcomes.

claims.failure_consequence: Repair delivery or measurement first; retain incomplete and failed attempts.

claims.scope_limit: Fixture apparatus calibration, not participant correctness or independent external validity.

claims.failure_consequence: Block participant execution and repair reference or intervention construction.

assumptions.failure_consequence: Canonical counts may be reported but substantive quality remains unresolved.

assumptions.failure_consequence: Stop and inspect cost accounting; do not claim successful budget feasibility.

constructs.name: Substantive communicated-answer correctness
constructs.definition: The whole answer communicates exactly the reference decision and its explanation is internally consistent with that communicated decision. Factual explanation accuracy against task evidence is unassessed.
validity_evidence: Masked answer-text coding with separate canonical field and calibration cases; factual explanation accuracy unassessed
validity_threats: Shared AI judge errors, ambiguity, concise explanations, task-induced answer format

constructs.name: Canonical decision correctness
constructs.definition: A parsable designated decision enum equals the reference decision, whether or not surrounding prose is internally contradictory or factually inaccurate.
validity_evidence: Known correct and incorrect enum fixtures
validity_threats: Good enum can coexist with incorrect explanation; JSON compliance is not comprehension

constructs.name: Intervention/reference validity
constructs.definition: Critical gaps produce unknown; eligible positive and negative restoration produce the appropriate decisive result; noncritical gaps leave a decisive result.
validity_threats: Author and implementations share specification error; cause-domain confounding

design.rationale: Independent recipient clones reuse one common actual donor per task. Fixed facts/EAL/conventional contexts at each position isolate the delivered context comparison; finite controls diagnose blanket abstention and restoration polarity mistakes.
design.setting: Synthetic fixture plus actual API participant execution
design.temporal_structure: Common donor with independently forked evidence interventions; recipients are not serial carryover sessions.
design.assignment_method: Complete crossing of eight cases, five positions and three reasoners, fixed seed 20261002 shuffling block and variant order.
design.allocation_concealment: Not applicable to an automated finite crossing; frozen assignments precede participant calls.
design.masking: Whole-answer coders receive masked answer text without reasoner, condition label, task evidence, scores or model names. They code the communicated verdict and internal explanatory consistency; factual explanation accuracy is unassessed.
design.comparator: Within-case and within-position facts vs EAL vs conventional; within-case/reasoner complete vs critical_gap vs restored_positive vs restored_negative; noncritical has its declared decisive comparator.

units.target_population_or_system: Finite eight AI-authored task instances and one pinned model
units.sampling_frame: Purposive two logic families × four availability causes

units.observational_unit: One recipient answer; 120 scheduled outputs clustered within eight common donors and crossed reasoners/conditions
units.analysis_unit: Task block, with finite per-condition and reasoner cell tables
inclusion_criteria: All eight frozen tasks and every scheduled recipient variant; actual API attempts included
exclusion_criteria: Unscheduled odd continuity snapshots and donor answers from recipient accuracy denominator
units.recruitment_or_selection: No people; separate AI author in same session. Cases deliberately cover logic and availability combinations; domains differ across causes.

sampling.method: Exhaustive execution of the fixed material crossing, not statistical sampling
sampling.sample_size_or_information_target: Eight common donors + 120 recipients =128 sessions; one repeat. 40 authored positions:32 decisive and 8 unknown.
inputs: Prior pilot reportedly had1, 280 reference unknowns from 20 authored positions and 25 ambiguous communicated answers; these motivate measurement/control design and are not an effect-size estimate.
material-checks.json: exact reference distribution and bounded reservation arithmetic

sampling.multiplicity: No confirmatory hypothesis tests; disclose every finite cell and disagreement.
sampling.attrition_or_loss: Missing, failed, malformed and unlabelled outcomes remain in120 planned denominator; not-run distinguished from incorrect observed answer.
sampling.result: Apparatus computation completed; empirical allocation has not been run. No principal power claim.
sampling.sensitivity_analysis: Compare one-repeat 128 sessions to two-repeat 256 sessions; maximum reservation 1.048576 vs2.097152 USD. If only canonical outputs can be measured, substantive feasibility remains unresolved.
sampling.stopping_implications: Budget/time stop leaves a partial feasibility result; no beneficial-case selection, budget reset or adaptive stopping for favorable accuracy.

analysis.preprocessing_lock: Keep exact raw answers; parse designated canonical decision separately. Mask identifiers before whole-answer coding; retain coder disagreement and adjudication.
analysis.exclusion_lock: Exclude donors and unscheduled continuity snapshots from recipient accuracy; exclude no recipient failures from planned-denominator coverage.

models.model_or_procedure: Deterministic finite-cell tabulation; block-paired descriptive reasoner and evidence contrasts. No p-values, principal power estimate, or population CI.
diagnostics: Canonical/whole-answer disagreement, contradictions, missing outputs, hash mismatch, control failures, unknown-cost attempts

contrasts: Critical gap compared with complete; positive and negative restoration compared with gap
all_of noncritical compared with restored_negative; any_of noncritical compared with restored_positive
analysis.uncertainty: No sampling-based precision claim. Stochastic repeatability unknown with one repeat; unlabelled substantive answers yield bounds treating unresolved as all wrong or all correct, never settled-success counts.
analysis.multiplicity: Descriptive tables only; no selected contrast promoted to confirmatory result.
analysis.missing_data: Distinguish not-run, provider failure, malformed output, missing label, ambiguous answer and contradiction; denominators remain explicit.
analysis.stopping_rule: Complete fixed schedule or stop at USD 2, 21600 seconds, usage/model mismatch, or integrity failure. A resume shares original cumulative ceilings.

design_assessment.decision_use: Choose a bounded feasibility pilot capable of delivering decisive reference outcomes and measuring ambiguity within USD 2; principal-study power remains unestablished.
design_assessment.effect_or_precision_basis: No population effect or statistical precision margin. Exact apparatus targets:88/88 reference agreements, 40/40 authored state patterns, 32 decisive and 8 critical unknown positions, 0 unintended unknowns. Empirical delivery/coding target120/120; stronger finite task pass for a reasoner requires 40/40 communicated verdicts correct with internally consistent explanations. Factual explanation accuracy remains unassessed.
design_assessment.pilot_basis: Reported prior reference-unknown saturation and 25 ambiguous answers motivate fresh mixed reference states and separate endpoints; they do not supply an effect-size or variance estimate.

8 cases, 1 repeat, 5 positions, 3 contexts; 8 donors+120 recipients

design_assessment.selection_rationale: The smaller design lacks cause coverage; two repeats exceed the conservative cap. One repeat covers every designated logic/cause/condition/context cell without claiming repeatability.
design_assessment.scenario_coverage: Exact complete, critical-gap, positive-restoration, negative-restoration and noncritical states plus trivial blanket-answer patterns. Provider/coding failures are retained. Statistical null, benefit/harm sampling models are inapplicable to this nonstatistical feasibility purpose.

nonstatistical_assessment.criterion: Exact finite reference/state coverage and affordable reservation; separate actual model/coding feasibility remains to be observed.
nonstatistical_assessment.assessment: Computed 88/88 authored/reference/method agreements; 40/40 explicit requirement-state checks; 32 decisive / 8 unknown / 0 unintended unknown; 8 positive + 8 negative + 8 noncritical controls. Always-undetermined correct 8/40, always-ready20/40, always-not_ready12/40. Selected worst-case reservation 1.048576 USD at configured prices below 2 USD. No principal power calculation.
nonstatistical_assessment.evidence: experiments/model_transfer/followup/material-checks.json; check_materials.py; review/independent-reference-review.json; actual pipeline results must be recorded before execution

evidence_restoration.reference_calibration: Apparatus checks, not live model accuracy
evidence_restoration.allocation: Eight common donors, fifteen independently cloned recipients per donor: five positions crossed with three reasoner contexts.
evidence_restoration.substantive_success: For a named reasoner, all 40 whole answers must communicate the correct decision with internal explanatory consistency. Factual grounding and explanation accuracy against task evidence are unassessed. Ambiguous, unresolved and missing outputs cannot establish success.
limits: Eight source tasks are deliberately AI-authored in the same orchestration; no independent human task validation.
No cause effect estimate because causes covary with task-domain wording.
No model-class, population accuracy, principal-study power, superiority or cost-savings claim.
